NativeSession.name: Authorization
NativeSession.description: Existing native login session. No new auth scheme, model key, MCP key or anonymous read.

Key.description: Case-sensitive original key; never trim or regenerate automatically.

OfficePart.description: Validated package-relative part; no host/drive/UNC path, backslash, dot segment, empty segment or traversal. URI percent-decoding is not applied to this identity.

RelativePath.description: Read-only .7 snapshot path, preserving the existing 512 Unicode-character upper bound.

OriginalFilename.description: Read-only .5 original filename; existing 256 Unicode-character bound is unchanged.

OriginalRef.description: Read-only subset of .5 OriginalRevision. No replacement .5 DTO; source text/C1 roots are never fabricated.

Producer.description: go_ooxml identifies the project source projection engine proposed by this candidate, not an existing third-party dependency. Runtime producers MUST contain actual engine/adapter versions and actual build SHA; synthetic vector hashes are never runtime evidence.

Limits.description: Frozen candidate budgets, not measurements. RSS is sampled for parent and owned child separately and together; this is not a hard memory sandbox or a guarantee that 50ms sampling observes every peak.

TaskRequest.description: Exactly one current-active .5 original revision. The client cannot provide source path, classification, arbitrary engine options, project or C1 identity.

TaskProgress.description: Entire progress may be null when unknown; total may be null. No invented native percentage.

NaturalLocator.description: Natural source address. Office path uses expanded XML names and same-expanded-name sibling indices (0-based; root index 0). No raw XML prefix, server path, binary byte offset or IR ordinal.

DerivedPassageLocator.description: Derived parent address plus chunk index, never a native page/block address.

SemanticParentRef.description: A passage cannot own children; semantic parents always have natural source locators.

TaskDiagnostic.description: At most 8 controlled diagnostics; no raw stderr, source text, credential, host path, PID or arbitrary native error.

Task.description: Only succeeded has a result; only failed has a failure code; only terminal states have completed_at. stopping/cleaning remain nonterminal while exit or cleanup is unproven, retaining the domain execution fence. Pure lease heartbeats do not increment revision.

OperationRecord.description: Complete original Task, command receipt or fixed rejection. Only a fully matching persisted rejection permits explicit abandonment of the corresponding recovery slot.

StructureManifest.description: Canonical preimage carrier for identity vectors/internal publication, not an additional public route or full-tree metadata response. Nodes in final tree preorder; no representation/node/parent derived IDs.

Representation.description: Published fixed representation. quality=complete covers only its declared profile; no OCR/unknown block completeness claim. Manifest is a digest commitment, not a full-tree response. root_document_node_id is derived and is excluded from representation identity.

ContentWindow.description: UTF-8 half-open derived window. A response cannot clip explicit endpoints. Cross-object containment and complete/end matching are checked against the fixed node.

Error.description: All errors including native-login 401 use this bounded new envelope and contain no private data. A hint is never enough to clear a recovery slot; DC05 must return the full matching record.

Error400.description: 400 bounded error: invalid_request. No private data; full fixed rejection recovery requires DC05.

Error401.description: 401 bounded error: unauthorized. No private data; full fixed rejection recovery requires DC05.

Error404.description: 404 bounded error: not_found. No private data; full fixed rejection recovery requires DC05.

Error409.description: 409 bounded error: foundation_policy_changed, document_policy_disabled, document_policy_changed, source_revision_changed, lifecycle_changed, source_archived, head_changed, producer_changed, unsupported_source, task_revision_changed, idempotency_conflict, original_integrity, document_integrity. No private data; full fixed rejection recovery requires DC05.

Error412.description: 412 bounded error: contract_mismatch. No private data; full fixed rejection recovery requires DC05.

Error429.description: 429 bounded error: capacity_exceeded. No private data; full fixed rejection recovery requires DC05.

Error503.description: 503 bounded error: unavailable. No private data; full fixed rejection recovery requires DC05.

x-validation-rules.strict_json: Reject unknown fields, duplicate keys and unpaired surrogates before canonical hashing; strings preserve exact Unicode scalar values with no trim/casefold/NFC.
x-validation-rules.integers: Only JS safe integers are accepted. Query integers are exact nonnegative decimal strings before typed conversion.
x-validation-rules.extensions: x-max-utf8-bytes and x-max-json-bytes are byte budgets. Named x-* predicates encode relational constraints not expressible by portable JSON Schema; the supplied AJV verifier executes them on synthetic examples.
x-validation-rules.authorization: Recheck current access for task acceptance/original/cache/publication and every fixed read. Archive alone does not revoke; revoked access hides all representation/node/window/receipt/cursor data.
x-validation-rules.task_core: One internal scanner/claim/lease/fence/domain quota core. Legacy code/project and new document/original_document payloads are dispatched separately; public cross-protocol reads return 404.
x-validation-rules.current_target: Only selected .7 current-active .5 original tuple is eligible for a new task. No implicit revision/lifecycle/producer/head substitution.
x-validation-rules.atomicity: No staged object is publicly readable; representation/tree/manifest and single source head activate atomically. Failure/cancel/CAS/fence mismatch preserves old head and history.
x-validation-rules.identity: New typed-LP prefixes/projections are exactly candidate Markdown section 6. Compute payload then preorder manifest then representation then node/parent IDs; no root-ID cycle.
x-validation-rules.content: start/end are 0-based half-open derived_utf8, never original binary offsets. Length, UTF-8 boundaries, hashes and node containment must match; explicit invalid ranges return 400 without guessed clipping. Required nullable own_reading_range identifies heading title/paragraph/text_block/passage own text and is contained in aggregate reading_range; pure containers/media have null.
x-validation-rules.cursor: Opaque ID32 bound to owner/domain/source/representation/parent/limit, with fixed first-issued 600s expiry and no renewal. Wrong scope/filter=400; revoked access=404.
x-validation-rules.recovery: Before any POST persist complete first body/key/digest/scope/target in this document family, 8 slots per owner, each 16KiB. Only a full matching fixed rejection allows explicit abandonment. Errors/hints/timeout never clear a slot.
x-validation-rules.cancellation: Termination signal/deadline is not exit proof. Until owned process group exit and cleanup are proven, retain stopping/cleaning nonterminal task and domain fence; no new execution/publication.
x-validation-rules.reading_text: rich_document_reading_v1 preserves source characters. Runs concatenate; explicit break=LF/tab=TAB; block/item/row separators=LF; cells=TAB; empty members join; media/unsupported zero text; no forced final LF. A single UTF-8-safe passage sequence covers all bytes once.
x-validation-rules.office_source: Source order is package/XML order, not visual reading order. Use internal relationships only. Unknown/revision/field/AlternativeContent structures become explicit unsupported blocks; no external fetch. Hidden PPTX slides remain with hidden flag.
x-validation-rules.performance: Candidate thresholds only, not measured API/business success. Parent+owned child RSS sampling is not hard isolation and can miss short peaks.
